purpose: static protocol capability review; no host authentication or model execution

findings.command_exec: Supports argv-only standalone sandboxed execution without a model turn
findings.command_exec_terminate: Targets the client-supplied connection-scoped process ID; does not establish cleanup of every process launched by an agent
findings.process_exited: Describes processes started with process/spawn, not an exhaustive worker process inventory
findings.thread_shell: Described as unsandboxed; excluded from assessment execution and probes

remaining: Verify per-case process cleanup, private state and reset behavior before advertising reused-worker support
